_comment: WATCHLIST — the search space for the smarter autonomous search (harness/search_once.mjs).
DEPENDENCY-FREE config. NO key material and NO RPC URL live in this file: each chain
names an ENV VAR (rpc_env) and the RPC URL is read from the environment at run time.
Each (chain, pair, set-of-per-DEX-pools) is compared CROSS-DEX exactly like the watcher's
SAME-PAIR mode: for a pair (base, quote) the search discovers each DEX's V3 pool, then
evaluates the A<->B / A<->C / B<->C cross-DEX cycles on recent blocks and records the gap.
Pair tokens resolve from sim/dex_registry.mjs TOKENS (per chain). A pair whose base or
quote token is NOT present for a chain (e.g. ARB on base, cbETH on arbitrum) is SKIPPED
gracefully by expandWatchlist — it is never an error. A WIDE search over many markets runs
SLOWLY ON A FREE RPC TIER BY DESIGN: small batch_size, few blocks_per_market, and the
throttle+429 backoff keep it under the free-tier rate limit instead of crashing.
MEASUREMENT ONLY: the search never trades and never holds keys.
